column5: TopN then CMSketch then histogram precedence is available only through the upstream-proven equality adapter; encoded-key construction and general range estimation remain external.

IndexAccessPath carries upstream-precomputed CountAfterAccess. The isolated equality adapter rejects full and arbitrary ranges rather than recomputing Go cardinality; ranger and statistics derivation remain external.
Source CountAfterAccess, and an exact upstream-limited ExpectedCnt result when supplied, reach PhysicalIndexScanPlan. Logical datasource statistics derivation remains external.
Rows times max(log2(max(row size, 1)), 0), scan and index factors, plus the signed source index-ID remainder feed bounded Cop task selection; broader cost trees remain external.

Empty represented index ranges immediately return zero-row TableDual. PointGet-admitted paths, Root/IndexReader, table, index-merge, TiFlash, double-read, multi-valued, and ordered paths fail closed; empty table-candidate range representation is external to this bounded index-only model.

LogicalDataSource owns represented access-path enumeration order and routes it to the bounded index-only task builder. Go expression/table/schema/partition/property construction and broad path enumeration remain external.
The bounded task sum carries CopSingleRead, zero-row TableDual, or explicit rejection; other Go task variants and cost comparison remain external.
The bounded Cop task exposes scan and cost; Root conversion deliberately rejects until a PhysicalIndexReader owner supplies network, concurrency, and reader-factor semantics.
